name: Explicit instance fields initialize per instance and enforce mutability

input.source_text: global mut $next = 0; class Item { let @fixed: Integer = 1; mut @id: Integer = ($next = $next + 1); public fun values() -> Array { %[@fixed, @id] } public fun replace() { @id = 9 } } let first = Item.new(); let second = Item.new(); let changed = first.replace(); %[first.values(), second.values()]

applicability.reason: Instance field construction and assignment are observable from source.
